newsitem.title: GERMANY: RWE Energie builds power plant in Saarland.
newsitem.headline: RWE Energie builds power plant in Saarland.

text.p: RWE Energie AG, the energy subsidiary of German diversified utility RWE AG, said on Wednesday that it plans to invest around 1.2 billion marks to build a hard-coal power station in the Saarland region.
The power station will have a capacity of 500 megawatts and is planned for completion by the end of the year 2004.

RWE Energie said that 900 megawatts of generation capacity from older power plants would be systematically shut down in tandem with the construction of the new plant, which will be located at the town of Ensdorf.
The group said that local partners from the state of Saarland would be involved in the construction and operation of the new plan.
